messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — PR #7892 needs 2x LGTM before today's 4:00pm PT cutoff. It's the p99 kv-cache latency fix; CI is green except a flaky `integration-test:cache-warmup` that retried and passed. @james_k @sarah can you spare a quick review? If we don't hit 2x LGTM by cutoff we should hold and ship tomorrow AM. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

james_k: On it, will take a look now. Prioritizing the latency regression check and the small change in cache eviction logic.

leo: I ran the profile locally — looks good, can't reproduce the flake. Happy to be second sign-off if one of you already +1s the test change.

sarah: I can be second sign-off but I'm heading into a meeting until 3pm PT. If you need me earlier, ping me in here and I'll try to hop out.

maria.g: Thanks. Quick note: the failing log was this snippet but retried ok:
```
E 2026-01-26 13:02:11 cache_warmup_test.go:142 timeout waiting for warmup
--- retry 1 ---
PASS
```
Not a functional regression as far as I can tell.

james_k: Reviewed main diff, left one tiny comment about a nil-check (already pushed a 1-line fix). Running e2e smoke now.

deploy-bot: merge-queue:hold set by @maria.g — awaiting approvals (reason: 2x-LGTM before 2026-01-26T16:00:00-08:00).

james_k: e2e smoke passed. +1 from me. :thumbsup:

sarah: +1 — looks safe to me. Sorry for the delay, meeting over. :white_check_mark:

maria.g: Awesome, got 2x LGTM. I'll merge and queue the cut. Command I'll run:
```
git checkout release/cut-2026-01-26 && git merge --no-ff pr/7892 && ./scripts/trigger-cut.sh --env=prod --tag=hotfix-7892
```

deploy-bot: pr/7892 merged by @maria.g into release/cut-2026-01-26. Cut queued.

leo: thanks all — monitoring p99 after rollout. If anything spikes we can revert with `revert-pr 7892` and hold the queue.

maria.g: Will monitor for 20m then announce in #incidents if anything odd. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :rocket:
